Ah my fault, I think i was getting posts mixed up. I don't have EURGBP data so I don't have the full history, but I bet if you looked left there's probably zone there holding up price. I see 2 ways to interpret what happened:

1. The flag is still forming, in which case you don't know which way price will go until a FL breaks to the up or down side. 2. This is a FO move deeper into the (assumed) zone to the left to take out stops before moving higher.

It could be an indication that it wants to go lower, but this is where you have to understand how this individual concept fits in context to the whole story. Its like taking the QM concept at face value and wondering why not all H, L, HH, LLs will reverse price. Hope that helps.
